label: common_0040_head_teacher_03
text: On behalf of the academy, I must apologize for\nthe late arrival of your enrollment documents.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_04
text: Ah. And also for my delay in introducing myself.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_05
text: I am the director of Naranja Academy. You may\ncall me Mr. Clavell.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_11
text: I am the director of Uva Academy. You may call\nme Mr. Clavell.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0040_mama_01
text: The director?! And you came in person to help\nmy [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0803)]sondaughter with h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser first day?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_06
text: Well, I am responsible for the entire academy—\nincluding any failures on its part...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_07
text: So here at last are the enrollment documents\nthat should have already been delivered to you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0040_mama_03
text: Since you’ve come all this way, can I at least\noffer you a cup of tea?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_08
text: Ah, no need to trouble yourself...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0040_mama_05
text: Why don’t you head back up to [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]your room[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and\nfinish getting ready for school? You’ll need your\r\nbag—and your hat as well![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0040_mama_06
text: Now, Mr. Clavell, you simply must join me for\na cuppa. This way...[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_09
text: Well, how can I refuse such a kind offer?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0040_head_teacher_10
text: Is your room upstairs? No need to concern\nyourself with me. Go on.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
